SECTION: FDFLT01 §3+§4 — the frozen primary endpoint, published before any run
INTEGER_CONVENTION: need_steps = ceil(T(f)); maturation event at episode_start + need_steps - 1; the episode must last at least need_steps consecutive steps
CONVENTION_MATCHES_PARENT: proven by the pre-run equivalence gate, which reproduces the FLRS02 developmental counts exactly
CENTRE_RULE: toroidal single-linkage over Y-occupied cells, adjacency distance <= CORE_R = 5.0

STATE_OPERATOR.C: multiple Y but one spatial centre

DIRECT_X_RESPONSE.neighbourhood: toroidal disc of radius CORE_R about each centre's toroidal centroid
DIRECT_X_RESPONSE.numerator: local X mass of the weaker centre
DIRECT_X_RESPONSE.denominator: local X mass of the stronger centre
DIRECT_X_RESPONSE.overlap: discs may overlap; the criterion is a scale-free ratio so no mass is partitioned or double counted
DIRECT_X_RESPONSE.centre_motion: the centroid is recomputed at the maturation event step
DIRECT_X_RESPONSE.ambiguous_boundary_X_births: not attributed to a centre at all; only the field state is read

PERSISTENT_CENTRE_IDENTITY.rule: maximum component overlap, then minimum toroidal centroid distance, then lexicographic centroid order
PERSISTENT_CENTRE_IDENTITY.role: analysis bookkeeping only; consumes no engine RNG
PERSISTENT_CENTRE_IDENTITY.tested: seven synthetic cases in the pre-run gate

SEVEN_CONDITIONS: F1 at least one dynamic Y birth occurs
F2 the Y lineage does not become extinct before functional maturation
F3 exactly two spatial Y centres form under the frozen toroidal centre rule
F4 the two centres remain spatially distinct for the complete primary maturation duration
F5 the weaker centre reaches the frozen direct local-X functional criterion
F6 no third spatial centre occurs before functional maturation completes
F7 X/source integrity remains valid through functional maturation
UNIT: one world; steps and episodes are never independent replicates
